registration_label: Prospective software test expectations recorded before executing these sequences
scope: Temporary local SQLite and loopback API state transitions. This does not test real model behavior, establish scientific effects, or attest upstream data.

generated_sequences.selection: Python random.Random(seed), uniform choice from the declared operation list after a fixed preparation spine

predeclared_invariants.exact_source_identity: Every reused reference retains its original ID, version and hash. Later object versions never replace earlier links.
predeclared_invariants.immutable_source: Original authored source objects and prior snapshots remain byte-equivalent under their exact hashes.
predeclared_invariants.copy_is_editable_not_empirical: A copy is a separate owned workspace_draft with exact original provenance, no copied outcomes or verification, and editable content preserved when copying an existing editable draft.
predeclared_invariants.owned_edit: Only the owning chat can update a draft at its exact latest version. An old draft remains readable unchanged.
predeclared_invariants.independent_fork: A fork retains its exact origin revision/hash and initial working state/history; later edits and messages change only that branch.
predeclared_invariants.cas_and_retry: Stale CAS and invalid references have no effects. Retrying an identical accepted request adds no projects, chats, versions, messages or links; changed-body reuse is rejected.
predeclared_invariants.prior_context: Exact prior discussion revisions retain their original snapshot hash and exclude later messages, state and artifact links.
predeclared_invariants.fixed_science_origin: New object versions saved through a captured chat facade attach to that original chat regardless of later active-chat selection; source payloads are unchanged.
predeclared_invariants.no_model_calls: Every scenario leaves the shared provider call ledger at zero. Authored fixture outcomes are never promoted as model findings.

negative_transitions: repeated request ID with different body
recovery: After each rejected transition, reload the authoritative exact snapshot and continue with a new explicit request ID; never silently retry a costly scientific operation.
public_api_scenarios: create two chats; queue an authored import under chat A; switch working state to B; completed object and job retain origin A
exact prior context GET remains unchanged after newer state/message
mismatched guide origin fails before any guide/provider invocation
failure_policy: Record expected versus observed and retain any failure reproduction. A failed invariant is a defect, not an excluded favorable test; coordinate a narrow correction before claiming the sequence passed.
